visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair in a dark t-shirt is sitting on a wooden balcony overlooking a lush green forest. She looks up and smiles. A portable projector and camping gear are visible on the balcony deck. (2) The scene cuts to her standing on the same balcony in beige overalls, looking out at the scenery. She then sits in a brown camping chair, holding a bowl of noodles with cheese. (3) Transitions to the interior of a car configured for camping with a white mattress. The woman is lying down, looking at the camera with a distressed expression. She holds up two black packages of 'Sofy' night pants. (4) Detailed shots follow: she pulls up her grey t-shirt slightly to show the waistband of the white night pants over her shorts. She stretches the fabric of the product to demonstrate elasticity and holds it up to a light source to show the ventilation holes. (5) She is shown sleeping in various positions (side, back) in the car on the mattress, appearing peaceful. Close-up graphic overlays point out the product's leak-proof ridges and side walls. (6) She sits in a camping chair outside, holding four different product packages, smiling broadly and giving a thumbs up. A final shot shows multiple packs of Sofy products spread out on a beige surface.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, medium-tempo acoustic pop BGM with a clear drum beat and synth chords. A young female voice speaks with a high-arousal, friendly tone, narrating her camping experience. (2) A subtle acoustic shift occurs as she changes topic to the sudden arrival of her period; the music continues, but her vocal delivery becomes slightly more dramatic and narrative. (3) A 'Whoosh' SFX signals the transition to product introduction. The sound of plastic packaging rustling is clearly audible. (4) Multiple 'Ding' and 'Pop' sound effects are used to punctuate visual demonstrations of the product's elasticity, ventilation, and side-wall height. The vocal tone remains energetic and persuasive. (5) The track concludes with the female speaker giving a enthusiastic recommendation over the upbeat BGM, maintaining high spectral brightness and clarity.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Conflict -> Solution -> Demonstration -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional vlog for Sofy Night Pants. It begins with a positive lifestyle hook about the joys of camping, introduces a common female problem (period arrival during travel/camping), and positions the product as the perfect, stress-free solution through feature demonstration and user testimonial.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator directly holds, wears, and describes the features and benefits of the Sofy Night Pants product throughout the video.
